headline: BLS E-Services reports 12% rise in Q2 net profit to Rs 20.5 crore
hook: Steady profit growth amid sharp revenue surge
summary: BLS E-Services reported a 12.4% year-on-year increase in net profit to Rs 20.5 crore for the second quarter. Total income saw a significant jump of 55.1%, reaching Rs 428.1 crore. Operating EBITDA grew by 43.8% to Rs 28.8 crore, reflecting improved operational efficiency. The company's Business Correspondent segment handled transactions worth over Rs 41,400 crore during this period.
why_it_matters: Strong revenue growth signals expanding footprint in digital services.

headline: BLS E-Services issues press release on Q2 and H1 financial results
hook: Second quarter scorecard for BLS E-Services
summary: BLS E-Services has formally submitted its unaudited financial results for the second quarter and half year ending September 30, 2026, to the stock exchange. The company also released a press release detailing these operational and financial figures. Retail investors tracking the stock can review the specific margin and revenue growth numbers in the official exchange filing.
why_it_matters: Quarterly numbers reveal the company's current operational health.

headline: BLS E-Services informs stock exchanges of share split credit confirmation
hook: Share split confirmation received from depositories
summary: BLS E-Services has updated the stock exchanges regarding the credit confirmation of shares from depositories following its equity share sub-division or split. This procedural update follows the company's previously approved corporate action to split its shares. Shareholders will see their holdings adjusted according to the approved split ratio. Indian retail investors holding the stock should verify their demat accounts for the updated share counts.
why_it_matters: Verify your demat account for updated share counts.
